issues.description: Constructor mismatch for class 'Developer': the problem statement and the template expect an initializer init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) (two parameters). The solution repository's Developer.swift defines init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?, age: Int) (an extra required 'age' parameter). At the same time, the solution's Client.swift calls Developer(name:monthsOfSwiftExperience:) (two-parameter form). This inconsistency in the constructor signature will cause compilation errors and will confuse students about the required initializer parameters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Developer initializer consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: remove the unintended 'age: Int' parameter from solution_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift so the initializer becomes init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) to match the problem statement, template, and all call sites. Alternatively (only if intentional), update the problem statement, the template, and all call sites (Client.swift) to include and document the new 'age' parameter or provide a default value for 'age' in the solution initializer.
